subject: Draft MAP milestone: Tech Eval runbook & timing (OptiHealth)
messages:
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@optihhealth.com>, Carlos Menendez <c.menendez@optihhealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP milestone: Tech Eval runbook & timing (OptiHealth)

Hi Emma / Carlos — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the MAP technical evaluation milestone (attached draft runbook v0.3). I captured what we discussed around success criteria, timelines, and owners. Key points: 

- Objective: validate that Redwood can meet OptiHealth production latency and cost constraints for the chat assistant prototype (1K DAU simulated).
- Success criteria (pass/fail gating):
  * P99 tail latency for 256-token responses <= 280ms in our dedicated environment (measured at 95th percentile of spikes)
  * Average tokens/sec cost <= $0.0008 per token for the expected prompt/response mix with batching and prefix caching enabled
  * Quality: ROUGE/F1 on the representative prompt set within 6% of your internal baseline (we'll use the 140-prompt eval set you shared)
- Model shortlist for the pilot: Mistral-7B-v0 (quantized), Llama-2-13B-chat (int8), and an 8-bit fine-tuned customer variant if available
- Test plan and timeline: 2-week tech sprint (week 1: setup & smoke runs; week 2: scale runs + cost tuning) — target completion: 2026-03-05

Attached: optih-map-tech-runbook-v0.3.pdf, latency-cost spreadsheet, model shortlist CSV.

Next asks from OptiHealth:
- Confirm the 140 prompt eval set + any must-pass prompts by Tue 02/24
- Provide the expected concurrent-user profile for the first pilot (peaks, not just daily averages)

Next asks from Redwood (owner in parens):
- Provision dedicated test pool in us-west-2 (dev_patel)
- Share initial smoke-run dashboard link and the eval harness (rishi_malhotra)
- Agree on final target close date for the MAP milestone — I proposed 2026-03-12 to leave time for contract redlines

If that all looks right I’ll update the MAP doc and schedule the kickoff.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop | Senior AE, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
From: Emma Li <emma.li@optihhealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Menendez <c.menendez@optihhealth.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP milestone: Tech Eval runbook & timing (OptiHealth)

Hi Lauren — thanks for the clear summary. Couple quick notes from our side after reviewing the draft: 

1) Success criteria: the P99 target is aggressive but aligns with our SLA goals. Can you confirm whether that P99 is measured at your edge or inside the dedicated pool? We need it measured from our app-hosted vantage (so including network).
2) Cost target: the $0.0008/token looks good as a place to start — we care about average inference spend across the pilot month, not just per-sample.
3) Model shortlist: would you add one smaller, low-cost baseline (e.g., 3B quantized) so we have a cheap fall-back for early A/B tests?

We'll provide the 140 prompts and the concurrent-user profile by EOD Tue (02/24).

Emma
Emma Li | Director, AI Product | OptiHealth Inc.
emma.li@optihhealth.com | +1 415 555 0123

On Mon, Feb 23, 2026 at 08:00 AM rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Emma — adding a 3B quantized baseline (we suggest Mistral-3B-q4) to the shortlist.
> Lauren / Dev: I sketched an initial test matrix and cost measurement approach in the attached spreadsheet. Key technical notes: 
> 
> - We'll run both latency-only (single-request) and throughput (sustained QPS) experiments. For latency, we'll run from an app-facing load generator in us-west-2 to capture network.
> - For cost calc: we will measure total tokens generated during scaled runs + infra amortized GPU time divided by tokens. That will be the metric compared to the $0.0008 threshold.
> - Caching: we'll include prefix caching as an on/off axis; for the first pass we should enable it to mirror your expected traffic shape.
> 
> I uploaded an initial sheet: optih-latency-cost-targets.xlsx (see attachment). Dev — can you provision the test pool tomorrow?
> 
> -Rishi

From: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Li <emma.li@optihhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP milestone: Tech Eval runbook & timing (OptiHealth)

On Tue, Feb 24, 2026 at 07:00 AM rishi.malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Dev — can you provision the test pool tomorrow?

Provisioning ETA: I can stand up a small dedicated pool in us-west-2 by 2026-02-25 18:00 PST. Notes: 
- Pool: 4x A40 equivalents (reserved for the 2-week sprint).
- Networking: will expose a test ingress endpoint for OptiHealth IP CIDR and our load-generator.
- Telemetry: Smoke dashboard link will be available via Drive link once runs begin.

Dependencies: need OptiHealth to confirm the IP CIDR whitelist and the prompt set. Also need the model binaries for any privately fine-tuned variant.

I'll mark dev_patel as owner for provisioning in the MAP doc.

—Dev
Dev Patel | Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@optihhealth.com>, Carlos Menendez <c.menendez@optihhealth.com>

Subject: RE: Draft MAP milestone: Tech Eval runbook & timing (OptiHealth)

Thanks all — updated plan below and next steps. I updated the Drive MAP doc and attached the runbook v0.3. High-level changes from feedback: 

- Added Mistral-3B-q4 as a low-cost baseline and clarified P99 measurement point (we will report both edge-measured and in-pool P99; optih should sign off on the edge-facing numbers as the gating metric)
- Provision ETA confirmed by Dev: pool ready 2026-02-25 18:00 PST
- Target milestone close: proposed 2026-03-12 (to include a week for joint readout + contract ops)

Immediate actions:
- Emma/Carlos: send prompt set + IP CIDR by EOD Tue 02/24 (Emma confirmed earlier)
- Rishi: post the smoke run dashboard link once initial runs start (owner for eval harness)
- Dev: confirm when the ingress endpoint is up and share the URL (owner for infra)
- Ben: I put you down to own the joint readout and success sign-off meeting scheduling (target week of 03/09)

If I don’t hear objections I’ll mark these items in the MAP and lock the timeline.

Best,
Lauren
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | +1 650 555 0199
